subject: SOC2 automation sourcing: scoping notes & consolidation RFP
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@drata.com>, Samir Khatri <samir@trustcenter.io>, Hannah Price <hannah.price@vendor-consult.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 automation sourcing: draft scope and ask

Team —

Following our internal review (Acme Corp RFP), we need a short vendor-side scoping reply so we can consolidate options. Attached is our draft_rfp_v1.pdf and a blank redwood_compliance-matrix.xlsx to help map features to controls. High-level ask: can you confirm the following in your response by EOD Thu 11/5?

- Which SOC2 controls you automate end-to-end vs require manual evidence collection
- Support for prefix/KV cache of evidence artifacts and retention windows (we need 3 years)
- Integrations: GCP service accounts, Okta, AWS CloudTrail, Datadog, and our internal S3 bucket patterns
- Time-to-onboard estimate for a production tenant (days) and typical CS touchpoints
- Licensing model: per-seat, per-agent, or per-organization (include enterprise tiers and any multi-year discounts)

We've got internal stakeholders on this thread to keep things tight: Neha (security/compliance) and Vivek (head of partnerships). Priya (me) will coordinate procurement intake. Monica — you are likely to be asked to validate onboarding items once responses land.

Please attach a capabilities slide or short PDF and an indicative price range. If you can include customer references for infra-heavy customers (scale >1000 hosts) that will help.

Thanks — looking to keep this lightweight to get to a consolidated shortlist next week.

--
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: draft_rfp_v1.pdf, redwood_compliance-matrix.xlsx
From: Elena Morales <elena@drata.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 automation sourcing: draft scope and ask

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear brief. Quick response from Drata side: attaching a 2-page capabilities summary (drata_capabilities.pdf) and a short sample onboarding timeline. Highlights:

- Coverage: we automate collection for the majority of common infra and identity controls (Okta, GCP, AWS logs, Datadog), with connectors that surface evidence artifacts into the evidence repository.
- Manual items: some org-specific policies and attestation evidence require customer input; we provide attestation workflows and scheduling automation to reduce manual overhead.
- Onboarding: typical production baseline in 10–18 business days with our standard CS package; expedited onboarding available (premium professional services).
- Pricing: enterprise tier is org-based with seat addons for auditors; multi-year discounts available for 2–3 year commits (we can propose a term sheet).

We can demo specific integrations next week. Two asks from our side to help scope accurately: 1) can you populate the matrix with your most critical controls (we marked a few in the sheet), and 2) confirm expected monthly ingest (events/day) so we can size retention/costs.

Best,
Elena Morales
Sr. Account Executive, Drata
doc: drata_capabilities.pdf
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 automation sourcing: draft scope and ask — internal summary

Team —

Summarized vendor responses received so far (Drata + initial outreach to TrustCenter + consultant):

- Drata (Elena): strong infra integrations, reasonable onboarding (10–18 days), enterprise pricing, multi-year discounts possible. Provided capabilities PDF.
- TrustCenter (Samir): indicated deeper control mapping for continued compliance program management and marketplace presence; asked for our control set to give a gap estimate.
- Consultant (Hannah Price): suggested a hybrid approach — use platform X for automation and keep a 6–12 month consultant engagement for playbook and runbook codification.

My recommendation: create a short shortlist (Drata + TrustCenter) and ask procurement to get firm term sheets. The consultant can be a paid add-on for the first 90 days to speed the API playbook and onboarding templates. Key evaluation criteria: automation coverage (percent of controls automated), onboarding days, data residency & retention SLAs, and enterprise pricing/discounts.

Action items:
- Priya: compile vendor responses into vendor_responses_summary.csv and share with Procurement (ACME) by Tue 11/9 EOD.
- Monica: quick CS risk read (2 bullets) on onboarding complexity for infra scale >1000 hosts.
- Aditya: confirm integration constraints around our S3 patterns and any custom agent needs.
- Vivek: if you agree with shortlist, please authorize procurement outreach (term sheets + security questionnaires).

Neha
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOC2 automation sourcing: draft scope and ask — go/no-go to procurement

All —

Thanks for the tidy summary, Neha. I approve moving the Drata + TrustCenter shortlist to formal procurement. Please proceed as follows:

1) Priya: send the vendor_responses_summary.csv to Acme procurement and request term sheets and formal pricing for 1-year and 3-year commitments. Include a clause request for enterprise-wide retention at 3 years and support SLAs.
2) Monica: include a one-paragraph onboarding impact statement for the SOW (we want to avoid >6 week rollout risk).
3) Aditya: flag any custom integration costs; if >2 dev-weeks, indicate as a red cost item.

Negotiation note: push for a 20% discount on list for 3-year commit or a trial credit that covers the first month of retention costs. If Drata is unwilling to move, escalate to legal for alternate contract language (we can accept capped liability in exchange for discount).

Priya — please loop Procurement (procurement@acme-corp.com) and include the Drive link to the RFP folder. I want a single consolidated term-sheet comparison by Fri 11/13 EOD.

-Vivek
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
